conflicts.statement: Strict-readiness text says 258 release handlers, while the deterministic FFDec bundle parser finds 129 exported script blocks whose event list explicitly includes release. The counting-method conflict is preserved and neither value is silently rewritten.
conflicts.readinessStatement: 258 release handlers and 388 edit-text definitions encode a large assessment state space.

conflicts.statement: Preserved source placement is basename-only-conflict in active course XML; neither source is rewritten or silently preferred.
The short root timeline and longer nested timelines are both authoritative structural facts; root frameCount is not treated as total behavioral duration.
